question: A scheme needs every member to recruit six new members. Starting from one person, at which level would recruits outnumber Earth's 8 billion people?
move: Any plan that needs ever more newcomers has a date when it must collapse.
ask: Does the offer I'm hearing earn money from a product, or only from signing up the next person?
trap: Guessing hundreds of levels, since six recruits each sounds modest.
hint: Multiply by six for each level and count until you pass 8 billion.
steps: Level n needs 6 to the power n new recruits
Level 10: about 60 million; level 11: about 363 million
Level 12: about 2.2 billion, still short of 8 billion
reference: Recruitment levels in a pyramid scheme, worked arithmetic, 2026
